full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic portrait looks upward at a man in a broad dark hat, round dark glasses, and a formal suit as smoke curls through the air around his face. The head and shoulders fill most of the frame, with the circular hat brim occupying the upper center and cutting into an almost black background. Wisps of pale smoke rise along the upper left and drift across the hat's edge, adding loose translucent shapes to the otherwise solid dark field. The man's face is seen from below: the nose projects against the light, the lips hold a cigarette, and the cheeks and chin are modeled with sharply graduated gray. Round lenses obscure much of the eyes, reflecting just enough light to show their rims and dark centers. Short pale hair catches a bright edge around the ears. A white shirt collar and small dark bow tie anchor the lower center, while the jacket shoulders spread into shadow at both bottom corners. The lighting appears strong from the upper left and somewhat forward, outlining the smoke, hair, and face while the lower right side drops away. The cigarette and its thin line of smoke form a small vertical counterpoint to the wide sweep of the hat. Fine film grain is visible in the lit skin and middle-gray background, but the deepest blacks remain broad and velvety. The pose is still and self-contained, and the low viewpoint makes the figure seem larger than the sparse setting. The overall composition balances a heavy dark silhouette with luminous smoke and a bright central face, creating a theatrical, slightly eccentric mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白电影式肖像从低处仰看一位男子：他戴宽檐深色帽和圆形深色眼镜，穿正式西装，烟雾在脸周围卷曲。头肩占据画面大部，圆形帽檐盘踞上方中央，切入几乎全黑的背景。几缕浅烟沿左上方升起，掠过帽边，给原本坚实的暗色域加入松散半透明形。男子面孔从下方可见：鼻梁在光前突出，嘴唇叼着香烟，脸颊和下巴由急剧渐变的灰阶塑造。圆镜片遮住大半眼睛，仅反射少量光，使镜框与深色镜片中心仍可辨认。耳旁短而浅的头发沾上明亮边光。白衬衫领和小深色领结锚定下方中央，西装肩部向底部两角的阴影里展开。光似乎强烈地从左上并稍靠前的方向射来，勾亮烟、头发和脸，右下侧则坠入黑暗。香烟及其细烟线成为宽阔帽檐的一个小型竖向对点。亮皮肤与中灰背景中可见细胶片颗粒，但最深黑色仍宽阔而柔绒。姿态静止且自足，低视点让人物比稀少的环境显得更大。整体构图以厚重暗剪影平衡发亮烟雾与中央明亮面孔，形成戏剧性而略显古怪的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photographic treatment is theatrical, with a low viewpoint, broad near-black masses, and small luminous details. Hard directional light makes selected edges bright while rounded surfaces shift quickly into charcoal shadow. Pale translucent wisps soften the geometry and create motion against dense dark space. Fine grain remains visible in middle values, while the darkest areas stay smooth and substantial. A large curved shape organizes the upper frame, and narrow bright accents concentrate attention near the center. The balance of formal stillness and drifting light texture gives the image an eccentric, dreamlike tension.
style_prompt_zh: 这类单色摄影处理富有戏剧性，低视点、宽阔近黑色块与少量发亮细节并置。硬定向光使选定边缘明亮，圆润表面则迅速转入炭灰阴影。浅而半透明的缕状形体软化几何，并在浓暗空间前制造动势。中间调保留细颗粒，最暗区域仍平滑而厚实。一道大弧形组织上部画面，狭窄亮点把注意力聚在中央附近。正式的静止与漂移的亮肌理相平衡，给图像古怪而梦境般的张力。
theme_en: A low-angle black-and-white portrait of a smoking man in a broad hat
theme_zh: 一幅仰视的黑白肖像：宽檐帽下叼着烟的男子
name: Federico Fellini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
